$comment: City Utility Twin AOI. Core box: Altstadt, Speicherstadt and HafenCity, decided 2026-10-05. Focus places and control points from OSM (ids below), queried 2026-10-05.
$elevationComment: Low and partly at marsh level. DGM1 over water is the WATER SURFACE, filled per body (about 2.0 m Elbe, 2.7 m Binnenalster), not a bed survey. Measured on the 2022 survey 2026-10-05: -4.4 .. 17.2 m; the lowest cells are a 184 m2 depression at 53.5407 N 10.0098 E and a few patches of 50-90 m2 at -2.2 m. The range stays wide enough to catch a wrong region, which is all it is for.

verification.$controlPointsComment: All four candidate summits are wooded (Harburger Berge), and Copernicus GLO-30 is a SURFACE model that includes the canopy, so they read high by design: measured 2026-10-05 Wulmsberg +7.2, Bredenberg +3.7, Falkenberg +7.7 m. Reiherberg (OSM node/249657520, ele 79) read +12.9 and +13.1 m in two runs, past the 12 m shell tolerance, and is excluded for that measured reason rather than by loosening the tolerance. The strongest evidence here is the open-ground seam offset (-1.2 m).

geobasis.$dgm1Comment: The 2022 vintage (airborne laser scan 2022, GeoTIFF), listed in the LGV catalogue under 'Geländemodelle Hamburg - DGM'. The 2021 archive is the 2020 survey and still shows the Ueberseequartier excavation (down to -9.8 m), measured 2026-10-05.
geobasis.$lod2Comment: The 2026-04-28 vintage (ALS 2022 plus image matching 2024/2025), not the 2016 one: HafenCity has changed since. Listed in the LGV catalogue under '3D-Gebäudemodell LoD2-DE Hamburg', range reads verified 2026-10-05.

$shellDrapeComment: The LGV imagery service covers Hamburg only, so the shell drape is blank where the shell reaches into Schleswig-Holstein and Niedersachsen. Known, accepted for P1.
